title: Keep POCT devices locked when passing QC is dated in the future
prompt:
Fix the synthetic POCT evaluator clearing a lockout using QC that has not happened yet. Change only lib/ohworks-poct-lockout.ts and add tests/ohworks-poct-future-qc.test.ts. Evidence: lib/ohworks-poct-lockout.ts:79-83 calculates elapsedHours and accepts every value less than or equal to qcFrequencyHours, including negative ages. Reproduced with lastQcResult=pass, lastQcAt=2026-10-10T10:00:00Z, now=2026-10-09T10:00:00Z, qcFrequencyHours=8, and priorLockoutActive=true: locked=false with a reason claiming the QC is within frequency. This evaluator supplies device lockout rows in the release-readiness demo.

Add a local guard for negative elapsed time before the passing-QC branch. Return locked=true, qcOverdue=false, and a deterministic explanation that the recorded QC timestamp is later than the evaluation time. A future run must not clear an existing lockout or qualify an initially unlocked device. Preserve failed-QC and no-QC precedence, exact-frequency boundary behavior, and the existing supervisor-override helper. Do not alter analyst permissions or authentication.

Test future QC with both priorLockoutActive values, equal timestamps, an ordinary recent pass, and the overdue boundary. Assert the returned lock state, reason, and qcOverdue flag. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks-poct-future-qc.test.ts. The planner asserted this reproduction and ran the six relevant existing suites: 140 passed. Open PRs and recent merges contain no duplicate repair. work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only these two files, using synthetic data and no external operations.
